# @chumlab/ui — Full Component Reference

> Production-grade React component library. TypeScript; styles precompiled from Tailwind CSS v4 (your project needs no Tailwind); targets WCAG 2.2 AA.
> This file is optimized for AI coding tools. For human docs, visit https://chumlab.com

Package: @chumlab/ui | React 18+/19 | MIT License
GitHub: https://github.com/chumlabhq/ui

## Install
npm install @chumlab/ui

## Styles (required)
Import once at the app entry. Without it components render unstyled:
import "@chumlab/ui/styles.css";

Precompiled, needs no Tailwind, ships no CSS reset. It carries only the
library's own utilities - your own arbitrary classes still need Tailwind.

If the project already runs Tailwind, import the tokens instead and let it
generate the utilities:
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@chumlab/ui/tokens.css";
@source "../node_modules/@chumlab/ui/dist";

## Import patterns
import { Button } from "@chumlab/ui";           // full library (dev only, no tree-shaking)
import { Button } from "@chumlab/ui/button";    // per-component (recommended)

Use the per-component subpath form in production. Kebab-case the component
name: Button → /button, MultiSelectDropdown → /multi-select-dropdown,
InternationalPhoneInput → /international-phone-input.

## Shared patterns
- Controlled: value + onValueChange (Checkbox and Switch: checked + onCheckedChange). Uncontrolled: defaultValue (defaultChecked). Never combine both.
- Every component accepts className on its root, and every component forwards a ref
  to its underlying DOM node.
- Dark is the default theme. Light: `class="light"` or `data-theme="light"` on <html>; the tokens and the components' `dark:` styles follow the same switch.
- The target is WCAG 2.2 AA; ACCESSIBILITY.md records each criterion's status and the test that holds it. Every component is keyboard operable.

## Customization — three layers, in order of reach
1. `className` on the root. It is merged LAST, so it WINS on conflict — including
   against the library's own `cl-*` token utilities. `className="rounded-none"`
   genuinely replaces the component's `rounded-cl-md`; you do not need `!important`
   and you should never emit it.
2. `classes` — a typed per-slot map for parts the root cannot reach:
   `classes={{ trigger: "...", content: "..." }}`. Your classes compose with the
   slot's defaults, and where one conflicts with a default utility, yours wins.
   Use it when className is not enough. `unstyled` strips the defaults entirely.
3. `--cl-*` design tokens — theme-level, propagates through every component.
   Override in `:root` and every component follows:
   `:root { --cl-accent: #7c3aed; --cl-radius-md: 0px; }`
   Tokens come in light/dark pairs; dark is the default, and light applies on
   `:root.light` or `:root[data-theme="light"]`.

Prefer the lowest layer that works. Reach for tokens when the change should apply
everywhere, className when it is one instance.

## Styling utilities available to generated code
The stylesheet a consumer imports (`@chumlab/ui/styles.css`) carries the `cl-*`
token scale plus the layout utilities the components themselves use. It is NOT a
full Tailwind build. If the target project does not run Tailwind, arbitrary
utilities you invent (`shadow-2xl`, `bg-purple-300`) will have no rule behind
them — prefer the `cl-*` tokens and the component's own props.

## Common mistakes (AVOID these patterns)
- ✗ `error="Required field"` — `error` is a boolean. Use `error errorMessage="Required field"` (two props). Same for `success` + `successMessage`.
- ✗ Passing both `value` and `defaultValue` — pick one (controlled OR uncontrolled), never both.
- ✗ `onChange`, `onSelect`, `onTabChange`, `onPageChange`, `onStepChange` — the value callback is always `onValueChange`. A `checked` prop (Checkbox, Switch) pairs with `onCheckedChange`; open state with `onOpenChange`.
- ✗ `placement="top"` on Tooltip — use `side="top"`. Drawer takes `side` too (`left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom`), not `placement`.
- ✗ CascadingDropdown value as a plain string — value is `Record<parentValue, string | string[]>`. Use key `"root"` for top-level (no-children) selections.
- ✗ Stepper `activeStep` / `currentStep` — those don't exist. Use `value` (current index, zero-based).
- ✗ `range` prop on Slider — pass `value={[min, max]}` (tuple) to enable range mode automatically.
- ✗ Forgetting `getRowId` on Table when row data mutates — without it, selection/expansion state drifts after reorder/edit.
- ✗ Reusing one `useState` across multiple component instances with different hardcoded props — clicks in one variant mutate the other's perceived state.
- ✗ Importing React types as runtime values — React types are TYPES, not runtime values. Import them with `import type` or inline `type` — e.g. `import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react"`. Never import FormEvent, ChangeEvent, ReactNode, etc. as runtime imports; it breaks at module load.
- ✗ Leaving callback parameter types implicit — always annotate them. e.g. `onValueChange={(v: string) => …}`, `onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => …}`. An un-annotated `(v) =>` fails strict typecheck with implicit-any.
- ✗ Emitting a control with a selected/active state (a chosen dropdown option, an active tab, a checked item) without wiring its selected indicator — verify the checkmark/highlight/active style actually renders; don't ship the control without its selected-state feedback.

## Choosing a selection component
| Use | When |
|-----|------|
| `RadioButton` | 2-6 options, all visible. Faster than opening a dropdown. |
| `Checkbox` | One independent toggle. Multiple checkboxes aren't a multi-select — group them yourself. |
| `Dropdown` | Single value, ≤ ~20 static options, no search needed. |
| `SearchableDropdown` | Single value, many options OR async-loaded options. |
| `MultiSelectDropdown` | Multiple values, ≤ ~20 static options. |
| `MultiSelectSearchableDropdown` | Multiple values, many options OR async search. |
| `CascadingDropdown` | Hierarchical options (Category → Subcategory). Value is a map keyed by parent. |

---

---

## Accordion

> A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections. Each item has a clickable trigger that toggles its content panel.

**Category:** Disclosure
**Keywords:** accordion, collapsible, expandable, toggle, faq, disclosure, panel

### Import

```tsx
import {
  Accordion,
  AccordionItem,
  AccordionTrigger,
  AccordionContent,
} from "@chumlab/ui/accordion";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from "@chumlab/ui/accordion";

export default function FAQ() {
  return (
    <Accordion selectionMode="single" collapsible defaultValue="q1">
      <AccordionItem value="q1">
        <AccordionTrigger>What is your return policy?</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>
          You can return any item within 30 days of purchase.
        </AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
      <AccordionItem value="q2">
        <AccordionTrigger>How long does shipping take?</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>
          Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.
        </AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
    </Accordion>
  );
}
```

This renders correctly with no additional props, classes, or setup.

---

### Prop Constraints (critical for correct usage)

These props have dependencies — using them wrong causes silent bugs:

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `collapsible` | Only works with `selectionMode="single"`. Ignored on `selectionMode="multiple"`. |
| `maxExpanded` | Only works with `selectionMode="multiple"`. Ignored on `selectionMode="single"`. |
| `defaultExpandAll` | Only works with `selectionMode="multiple"` AND uncontrolled mode. |
| `storageKey` | Only works in uncontrolled mode (no `value` prop). |
| `value` + `defaultValue` | Never combine. Use one or the other. |
| `value` requires `onValueChange` | Controlled mode — both are needed together. |

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

- `data-state="open|closed"` — on item, trigger, and content
- `data-disabled` — on disabled items/triggers
- `data-pending` — during async preventClose
- `data-orientation="vertical|horizontal"` — on root
- `data-value` — item's unique value string
- `data-selection-mode="single|multiple"`, `data-size`, `data-variant` — on root
- `data-accordion-expand-print="true"` — on root when `expandOnPrint` is set. The
  print stylesheet the component ships keys off it: `[data-accordion-expand-print="true"]`
  forces every `data-state="closed"` panel open for print and unhides its
  `aria-hidden` content.
- `data-accordion-print-styles` — marks the injected print stylesheet itself, so
  a second accordion on the page does not inject a second copy.

**DOM nesting:** root `<div>` → item `<div>` → heading `<h3>` → trigger `<button>` + content `<div role="region">`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Accordion.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `selectionMode` **(required)** | `"single"` \| `"multiple"` | — | Selection mode: single or multiple expanded items. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical"` \| `"horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | Layout orientation for keyboard navigation. |
| `dir` | `"ltr"` \| `"rtl"` | `"ltr"` | Text direction. Reverses the horizontal arrow keys and sets `dir` on the root; the layout itself does not mirror. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables all accordion items. |
| `loop` | boolean | `true` | Whether keyboard navigation wraps from last to first item. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for accordion sub-elements. |
| `headingLevel` | `1` \| `2` \| `3` \| `4` \| `5` \| `6` | `3` | HTML heading level for accordion item triggers. |
| `children` **(required)** | object | — | React.ReactNode — AccordionItem children. |
| `asChild` | boolean | `false` | Merges accordion props onto a child element via Slot. |
| `size` | `"sm"` \| `"md"` \| `"lg"` | `"md"` | Preset size variant. |
| `variant` | `"default"` \| `"bordered"` \| `"separated"` \| `"flush"` | `"default"` | Visual style variant. |
| `animationEasing` | string | `"ease-in-out"` | CSS easing function for expand/collapse animation. |
| `animationDuration` | number | `300` | Duration in milliseconds for expand/collapse animation. |
| `reduceMotion` | boolean \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `defaultExpandAll` | boolean | `false` | Expands all items on initial render. |
| `defaultValue` | — | — | Initial expanded item for uncontrolled usage: a string with `selectionMode="single"`, a string[] with `"multiple"`. Use `value` instead for controlled usage. |
| `onValueChange` | — | — | Fires when the expanded items change: with a string, or null when the last item closes, for `selectionMode="single"`; with a string[] for `"multiple"`. Not `onChange`. |
| `expandOnPrint` | boolean | `false` | Expands all items when printing. |
| `storageKey` | string \| object | — | Key or config for persisting expanded state to storage. |
| `onKeyDown` | object | — | (event: KeyboardEvent, itemValue: string \| null) => void |
| `preventClose` | object | — | (value: string) => boolean \| Promise<boolean> |
| `preventCloseTimeout` | number | `10000` | Timeout in ms for the preventClose callback. |
| `onFocusCapture` | object | — | (event: FocusEvent) => void |
| `onBlurCapture` | object | — | (event: FocusEvent) => void |
| `aria-busy` | boolean | — | ARIA busy state for async content. |
| `aria-live` | `"off"` \| `"polite"` \| `"assertive"` | — | ARIA live region behavior. |
| `announceExpanded` | boolean | `false` | Announces expanded state changes to screen readers. |

### Ref API (AccordionRef)

```tsx
const ref = useRef<AccordionRef>(null);

// Use in JSX
<Accordion ref={ref} selectionMode="multiple">...</Accordion>

// Available methods:
ref.current?.expandAll()             // Open all items (multiple mode only)
ref.current?.collapseAll()           // Close all items
ref.current?.expand("item-1")        // Open specific item
ref.current?.collapse("item-1")      // Close specific item
ref.current?.toggle("item-1")        // Toggle specific item
ref.current?.getExpandedValues()     // Returns string[] of open items
ref.current?.isExpanded("item-1")    // Returns boolean
ref.current?.getItemCount()          // Returns number
ref.current?.focusItem("item-1")     // Focus a trigger (optionally scroll into view)
ref.current?.element                 // Root HTMLDivElement
```

### Sub-component Props

Generated from the types by `scripts/build-subcomponent-schemas.mjs`.

#### AccordionItem

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | Identifies this item. Matches the values passed to the accordion's `value` or `defaultValue`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | Disables this item alone. It stays visible but cannot be toggled and leaves the tab order. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content rendered inside this element. |
| `asChild` | `boolean \| undefined` | Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props. |
| `onExpandedChange` | `((isExpanded: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | Fires when the item's expanded state changes. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string \| undefined` | Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object. |

#### AccordionTrigger

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content rendered inside this element. |
| `expandedIcon` | `ReactNode` | Icon shown while the item is expanded. Replaces the default chevron. |
| `collapsedIcon` | `ReactNode` | Icon shown while the item is collapsed. Replaces the default chevron. |
| `iconPosition` | `"start" \| "end" \| "none" \| undefined` | Which end of the trigger the icon sits at — `start` before the text, `end` after it — or `"none"` to drop it. |
| `asChild` | `boolean \| undefined` | Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props. |
| `subtitle` | `ReactNode` | Secondary line rendered under the trigger's label. |
| `iconAnimation` | `"none" \| "rotate" \| "switch" \| undefined` | How the icon changes on toggle: rotate the chevron, switch between the two icons, or neither. |
| `leftSlot` | `ReactNode` | Content placed before the label, inside the trigger. |
| `rightSlot` | `ReactNode` | Content placed after the label and before the icon. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string \| undefined` | Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object. |

#### AccordionContent

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content rendered inside this element. |
| `keepMounted` | `boolean \| "visited" \| undefined` | When the panel's children are in the DOM. `"visited"` (default): from the first expand onward. `true`: always, even before the first expand, so an exit animation or a measurement has a node to read. `false`: only while expanded — they unmount each time it collapses. |
| `animationDuration` | `number \| undefined` | Expand and collapse duration in milliseconds. |
| `animationEasing` | `string \| undefined` | CSS easing function for the expand and collapse transition. |
| `asChild` | `boolean \| undefined` | Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props. |
| `lazyLoad` | `boolean \| undefined` | Delays rendering the panel's children until it is first expanded. |
| `onOpenStart` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | Fires when the expand transition begins. |
| `onOpenEnd` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | Fires when the expand transition finishes. |
| `onCloseStart` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | Fires when the collapse transition begins. |
| `onCloseEnd` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | Fires when the collapse transition finishes. |

#### AccordionShimmer

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reduceMotion` | `boolean \| "auto" \| undefined` | Whether to stop the shimmer animation. `"auto"` follows the OS reduced-motion setting. |
| `classes` | `AccordionShimmerClasses \| undefined` | Class overrides for this component's slots. |
| `unstyled` | `boolean \| undefined` | Drops the decorative default classes and keeps the structural ones, along with focus, keyboard and ARIA wiring. |
| `count` | `number \| undefined` | How many placeholder items to draw. |
| `size` | `AccordionSize \| undefined` | Matches the accordion size the placeholder stands in for. |
| `variant` | `AccordionVariant \| undefined` | Matches the accordion variant the placeholder stands in for. |
| `animate` | `boolean \| undefined` | Whether the placeholder pulses. Set false for a still skeleton. |
| `className` | `string \| undefined` | Additional classes for the root element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties \| undefined` | Inline styles for the root element. |
| `showContent` | `boolean \| undefined` | Also draws a placeholder for the expanded panel, not just the triggers. |
| `asChild` | `boolean \| undefined` | Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props. |

---

### Styling Guide

> **A plain utility replaces the library's for that property, in every state.**
> `classes={{ slot: "text-red-500" }}` drops the library's `hover:text-…` and
> `data-[state=…]:text-…` on that slot as well — otherwise they would sit beside
> your class and win in their own state, leaving your override in the DOM and
> inert. Pass your own variant to keep one: `"text-red-500 hover:text-red-400"`.
> A variant YOU pass is never dropped.

#### How class merging works

The component has three styling modes:

1. **Default** (`unstyled=false`, no `classes`): Uses `DEFAULT_ACCORDION_CLASSES` — fully styled with dark mode support.
2. **Partial override** (`unstyled=false`, partial `classes`) — your classes compose with that slot's defaults; slots you don't name keep theirs.

**A plain utility of yours wins over every default in its group on that slot, states included.**
`classes={{ control: "bg-green-500" }}` paints green in every state, where a default
`data-[state=checked]:` background would otherwise keep winning. To restyle one state only,
pass that state's own variant (`data-[state=checked]:bg-green-500`). Defaults in other groups stay.

3. **Unstyled** (`unstyled=true`): All slots start as empty strings. You must provide everything via `classes`.

```tsx
// Adds to the trigger's default classes; a utility here that conflicts
// with a default (another padding, another background) replaces it:
<Accordion classes={{ trigger: "my-custom-trigger px-6" }} />

// The other slots (item, body, icon, etc.) keep their defaults.
```

#### Slot → element

| Slot | Element |
|------|---------|
| `root` | The accordion's outer element. |
| `item` | Each item's wrapper. Carries the variant's border treatment. |
| `header` | The heading element the trigger sits inside. |
| `trigger` | The `<button>` inside each item's heading. |
| `itemIcon` | An icon rendered before the label, when one is passed. |
| `itemText` | The trigger's label text. |
| `description` | The optional line under the trigger's label. |
| `triggerActions` | The slot after the label for controls that are not the trigger itself. |
| `icon` | The wrapper around the expand/collapse indicator. |
| `itemIndicator` | The chevron glyph itself, inside the `icon` slot. |
| `content` | The animating panel — the grid whose row goes `0fr` to `1fr`. |
| `body` | The padded region inside the panel that holds the content. |

`AccordionShimmer` has its own map: `root`, `item`, `trigger`, `itemText`,
`titleBar`, `descriptionBar`, `icon`, `body` — `titleBar` and `descriptionBar`
are the placeholder bars standing in for the label and its description.

#### CSS custom properties

| Variable | Set by | Controls | Default |
|----------|--------|----------|---------|
| `--cl-accordion-content-height` | the component, on each panel element | The panel's open height, measured and written by `AccordionContent` before it animates. The `max-height` of an opening panel reads `var(--cl-accordion-content-height, auto)`, so the fallback is what renders if the keyframes are missing. | none — written per panel at runtime |

You do not set this one; it is listed because it is the whole animation
contract. It shipped once with its keyframes absent from `dist`, and a consumer
had no way to know the variable existed or why the panel would not animate.

#### Slot → visual mapping

Use this to know which slot to change for a given visual outcome:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ root                                                 │
│                                                      │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ item                                          │   │
│  │                                               │   │
│  │  ┌─ header ──────────────────────────────┐  │   │
│  │  │ ┌─ trigger ──────────────────────────┐ │  │   │
│  │  │ │ [itemIcon] [itemText] [triggerActions] [icon] │ │   │
│  │  │ │               └─ description                │ │  │   │
│  │  │ └────────────────────────────────────┘ │  │   │
│  │  └────────────────────────────────────────┘  │   │
│  │                                               │   │
│  │  ┌─ content (animation layer) ─────┐  │   │
│  │  │ ┌─ body ─────────────────────┐ │  │   │
│  │  │ │  body (your text/elements)      │ │  │   │
│  │  │ └───────────────────────────────────┘ │  │   │
│  │  └────────────────────────────────────────┘  │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                      │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ item (next)                                   │   │
│  │ ...                                           │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| "I want to change..." | Slot to use | Notes |
|------------------------|-------------|-------|
| Overall container width/bg | `root` | |
| Border between items | `item` | Use `border-b` and `last:border-b-0` |
| Trigger background on hover | `trigger` | Use `hover:bg-*` |
| Trigger text color | `trigger` | Includes font weight, size from `size` prop |
| Expanded/collapsed text color | `trigger` | Target via `data-state` in CSS: `[data-state=open]:text-blue-600` |
| Chevron icon color/size | `icon` | Rotation is automatic via `iconAnimation` |
| Subtitle appearance | `description` | Below the main trigger label |
| Content text styling | `body` | Wraps your children |
| Open/close animation speed | `content` | Must keep `overflow-hidden transition-[max-height,opacity,visibility]` |
| Extra spacing inside content | `body` | Inner wrapper if you need it |
| Heading semantics (h1-h6 tag) | `header` | Rarely styled — use for CSS resets only |

#### Dark mode

The default classes use Tailwind's `dark:` prefix. Dark mode activates when `<html class="dark">` is present (Tailwind's class strategy).

```tsx
// Default classes already handle dark mode:
// trigger: "text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"

// When overriding, always provide both light and dark variants:
<Accordion classes={{
  trigger: "text-gray-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800",
  body: "text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300",
}} />
```

#### Styling via data attributes (CSS/Tailwind)

Every item and trigger expose `data-state="open|closed"`. Use this for state-dependent styling without JavaScript:

```tsx
// Tailwind arbitrary variants:
<Accordion classes={{
  item: "[&[data-state=open]]:bg-blue-50 dark:[&[data-state=open]]:bg-blue-900/20 border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700",
  trigger: "[&[data-state=open]]:text-blue-600 dark:[&[data-state=open]]:text-blue-400 [&[data-state=open]]:font-semibold",
  icon: "[&[data-state=open]]:text-blue-600 dark:[&[data-state=open]]:text-blue-400",
}} />
```

Or in plain CSS:

```css
[data-state="open"] > button { color: #2563eb; }
[data-state="closed"] > button { color: #374151; }
[data-disabled] > button { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
```

#### Size + variant interaction with classes

`size` and `variant` props add extra classes on top of `classes`. They are always applied. If you set `classes.trigger`, the size padding (`px-4 py-4 text-sm` for md) is still added. To take full control, use `unstyled`:

```tsx
// Full control — no defaults, no size/variant classes:
<Accordion selectionMode="single" collapsible unstyled classes={{
  root: "divide-y divide-gray-200 dark:divide-gray-700",
  trigger: "w-full flex justify-between py-4 text-left text-base font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white",
  body: "pb-4 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400",
  content: "overflow-hidden transition-[max-height,opacity,visibility]",
  icon: "h-5 w-5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 transition-transform duration-200",
}}>
```

#### Complete themed example: "macOS Settings" style

```tsx
<Accordion
  selectionMode="single"
  collapsible
  unstyled
  classes={{
    root: "rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm",
    item: "border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700 last:border-b-0",
    trigger:
      "flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-medium text-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-700/50 transition-colors",
    itemText: "flex-1 text-left",
    body: "px-4 pb-3 text-[13px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 leading-relaxed",
    content: "overflow-hidden transition-[max-height,opacity,visibility]",
    icon: "h-3.5 w-3.5 text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500 transition-transform duration-200",
    icon: "shrink-0",
  }}
  animationDuration={200}
  animationEasing="ease-out"
>
  <AccordionItem value="general">
    <AccordionTrigger
      leftSlot={<span className="text-base">⚙️</span>}
    >
      General
    </AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>
      Configure general application settings.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="appearance">
    <AccordionTrigger
      leftSlot={<span className="text-base">🎨</span>}
    >
      Appearance
    </AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>
      Customize theme, fonts, and colors.
    </AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

---

### Patterns

#### Controlled accordion

```tsx
const [openItem, setOpenItem] = useState<string | null>("settings");

<Accordion selectionMode="single" collapsible value={openItem} onValueChange={setOpenItem}>
  <AccordionItem value="settings">
    <AccordionTrigger>Settings</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>...</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="billing">
    <AccordionTrigger>Billing</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>...</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

#### Multiple with limit

```tsx
<Accordion selectionMode="multiple" maxExpanded={2} defaultValue={["a", "b"]}>
  <AccordionItem value="a">...</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="b">...</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="c">...</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

#### Keeping content mounted

`AccordionContent`'s `keepMounted` takes three values: `"visited"` (default) mounts the panel's children on the first expand and keeps them, `true` mounts them from the start (an exit animation or a measurement has a node to read), and `false` unmounts them each time the panel collapses.

```tsx
<AccordionContent keepMounted>{/* in the DOM before the first expand */}</AccordionContent>
<AccordionContent keepMounted={false}>{/* gone whenever collapsed */}</AccordionContent>
```

#### Persist to localStorage

```tsx
<Accordion selectionMode="multiple" storageKey="sidebar-sections">
  ...
</Accordion>
```

#### Loading state

```tsx
{isLoading ? (
  <AccordionShimmer count={3} variant="bordered" />
) : (
  <Accordion selectionMode="single" collapsible variant="bordered">
    {items.map(item => (
      <AccordionItem key={item.id} value={item.id}>
        <AccordionTrigger>{item.title}</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionContent>{item.body}</AccordionContent>
      </AccordionItem>
    ))}
  </Accordion>
)}
```

---

### AccordionShimmer classes

`AccordionShimmer` is a component in its own right, not a part of Accordion —
Accordion never renders it, the consumer does. It has its own anatomy and its own
`classes` bag; Accordion's keys do not reach it.

```
root
└── item
    ├── trigger
    │   ├── itemText
    │   │   ├── titleBar
    │   │   └── descriptionBar
    │   └── icon
    └── body
        └── descriptionBar
```

```tsx
<AccordionShimmer
  count={3}
  showContent
  classes={{
    item: "border-b border-gray-100",
    titleBar: "h-4 rounded bg-slate-200",
    descriptionBar: "h-3 rounded bg-slate-100",
  }}
/>
```

`unstyled` works the same way it does elsewhere: decorative classes are stripped,
structural ones stay. The pulse is in the defaults, so `unstyled`, `animate={false}`
and `prefers-reduced-motion` each switch it off.

### Keyboard Interactions

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the next trigger in the tab order. |
| `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp` | Moves focus between triggers. `orientation="horizontal"` uses `ArrowRight`/`ArrowLeft` instead. Disabled items are skipped, and `loop` wraps past the ends. |
| `Home`, `End` | Moves focus to the first or last trigger. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Toggles the focused item. In `selectionMode="single"` without `collapsible`, the open item cannot be closed this way. |

---

### Anti-patterns

```tsx
// ❌ DON'T: Combine value + defaultValue
<Accordion selectionMode="single" value={val} defaultValue="item-1" />

// ❌ DON'T: Use collapsible with selectionMode="multiple" (it's ignored)
<Accordion selectionMode="multiple" collapsible />

// ❌ DON'T: Use storageKey with controlled mode (value prop)
<Accordion selectionMode="single" value={val} storageKey="my-key" />

// ❌ DON'T: Copy the default classes into an override; they are already there
<Accordion classes={{ trigger: "flex w-full items-center px-4 py-4 my-trigger" }} />
// ✅ DO: Pass only what you change; it composes with the defaults
<Accordion classes={{ trigger: "my-trigger" }} />

// ❌ DON'T: Use maxExpanded with selectionMode="single"
<Accordion selectionMode="single" maxExpanded={3} />

// ❌ DON'T: Forget onValueChange with controlled value
<Accordion selectionMode="single" value={val} />
// ✅ DO: Always pair value with onValueChange
<Accordion selectionMode="single" value={val} onValueChange={setVal} />
```

---

### AI Instructions

- **Always set `selectionMode`** — it's required. Use `"single"` for FAQ/settings, `"multiple"` for checklists/filters.
- **Always add `collapsible`** to `selectionMode="single"` unless you intentionally want one item always open.
- **Use `defaultValue` for uncontrolled**, `value` + `onValueChange` for controlled. Never mix.
- **Pass only what you change in `classes`** — a slot's classes compose with its defaults, and a conflicting utility of yours wins, so there is no need to repeat the layout classes.
- **Use `unstyled` for full custom styling** rather than fighting defaults.
- **Provide meaningful `value` strings** on AccordionItem — they're used for storage, controlled state, and callbacks.
- **Set `headingLevel`** appropriately for your page's heading hierarchy (default is `h3`).
- **Safe defaults:** `selectionMode="single" collapsible defaultValue="first-item"` works for most use cases.

---

---

## Avatar

> A circular (or shaped) user representation showing an image, initials derived from a name, or custom fallback content. Includes group stacking, status indicators, notification badges, tooltips, and shimmer loading.

**Category:** Display
**Keywords:** avatar, profile, user, photo, initials, group, badge, status, shimmer

### Import

```tsx
import {
  Avatar,
  AvatarGroup,
  AvatarGroupCount,
  AvatarBadge,
  AvatarShimmer,
  AvatarGroupShimmer,
} from "@chumlab/ui/avatar";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from "@chumlab/ui/avatar";

export default function UserList() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
      {/* Image avatar */}
      <Avatar
        src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=150&h=150&fit=crop"
        alt="John Doe"
        name="John Doe"
      />

      {/* Initials avatar (auto-colored) */}
      <Avatar name="Jane Smith" autoColor />

      {/* Grouped avatars with overflow */}
      <AvatarGroup maxVisible={3}>
        <Avatar name="Alice" autoColor />
        <Avatar name="Bob" autoColor />
        <Avatar name="Charlie" autoColor />
        <Avatar name="Diana" autoColor />
        <Avatar name="Edward" autoColor />
      </AvatarGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

This renders correctly with no additional props, classes, or setup.

---

### Prop Constraints (critical for correct usage)

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `autoColor` | Requires `name` to generate colors. Without `name`, has no effect. |
| `colors` | Only used when `autoColor={true}`. Ignored otherwise. |
| `bordered={true}` | Uses auto-generated border color if `autoColor` is on, otherwise defaults to white. Pass a CSS string for explicit color. |
| `maxInitials` | Only affects initials display. Ignored when `src` loads successfully. |
| `loading={true}` | Renders shimmer in place of the avatar. Overrides `src`/`name`/`fallback`. |
| `status` | Can be a string shorthand (`"online"`) or a config object (`{ type: "online", position: "bottom-right" }`). |
| AvatarGroup `maxVisible` | Hides excess children and shows a surplus count. Set `total` separately if you're rendering a subset from an API. |
| AvatarGroup `ringColor` | The ring between stacked avatars. Match to your background color for clean overlap (e.g., `ringColor="#111827"` on dark bg). |
| AvatarGroup `layout` | `"stack"` overlaps, `"grid"` uses CSS grid, `"inline"` uses inline-flex. Only `"stack"` uses `spacing` and `ringColor`. |

---

### Content Fallback Hierarchy

The avatar resolves its display in this order:

1. **Image** — if `src` is provided and loads successfully
2. **Initials** — derived from `name` (e.g., "John Doe" → "JD"), takes priority over fallback
3. **Fallback** — if `fallback` ReactNode is provided and no `name` is set
4. **Empty** — renders an empty circle

If an image fails to load, it falls back to step 2/3 automatically. Note: when both `name` and `fallback` are provided, initials win.

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

- `data-has-image` — on Avatar root when image is loaded (boolean)
- `data-shape="circle|rounded|square"` — on Avatar root
- `data-chumlab="avatar-dark"` — not on the avatar: on the `<style>` element Avatar adds to `<head>` once, holding its dark-theme rules

**DOM nesting:** Avatar root `<div>` → inner `<div>` → (`<img>` | initials `<span>` | fallback `<span>`) + optional status `<span>`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Avatar.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | string | — | User's display name, used for initials and accessible labels. |
| `src` | string | — | Image URL for the avatar. Falls back to initials, then fallback content. |
| `alt` | string | — | Alt text for the avatar image. |
| `size` | `"xs"` \| `"sm"` \| `"md"` \| `"lg"` \| `"xl"` \| number | `"md"` | Avatar size as a preset or numeric pixel value. |
| `shape` | `"circle"` \| `"square"` \| `"rounded"` | `"circle"` | Visual shape of the avatar. |
| `maxInitials` | number | `2` | Maximum number of initials to show. |
| `fallback` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom fallback content when no image or name is available. |
| `autoColor` | boolean | `false` | Generates a deterministic background color from the name. |
| `colors` | object | — | Custom color palettes for auto-colored mode. |
| `bordered` | boolean \| string | — | Adds a border ring. Pass true for default color or a CSS color string. |
| `status` | `"online"` \| `"offline"` \| `"away"` \| `"busy"` \| object | — | Presence status indicator. Pass a string for defaults or a config object. |
| `tooltip` | object | — | Tooltip shown on hover. Pass a string/ReactNode or a config object. |
| `imageConfig` | object | — | Advanced image loading configuration (srcSet, loading, decoding, CORS). |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for avatar sub-elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `textStyle` | object | — | CSSProperties — Inline styles for the initials text. |
| `loading` | boolean | `false` | Shows a loading shimmer placeholder. |
| `reduceMotion` | boolean \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting. |
| `onLoad` | object | — | (event: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => void — Fires when the avatar image finishes loading, with the image's native load event. |
| `onError` | object | — | (event: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => void — Fires when the avatar image fails to load, with the image's native error event. |
| `asChild` | boolean | `false` | Merges avatar props onto the child element via Slot. |
