## DatePicker

> A full-featured date picker supporting single, range, and multiple date selection with calendar popover, presets, markers, locale support, and keyboard navigation.

**Category:** Form Input
**Keywords:** datepicker, date, calendar, range, date-range, multiple-dates, presets, markers, locale, form, input

### Import

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from "@chumlab/ui/date-picker";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { DatePicker } from "@chumlab/ui/date-picker";

export default function MyForm() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  return (
    <DatePicker
      value={date}
      onValueChange={(d) => setDate(d)}
      label="Select a date"
      placeholder="Pick a date..."
    />
  );
}
```

This renders correctly with no additional props, classes, or setup.

---

### Prop Constraints (critical for correct usage)

These props have dependencies -- using them wrong causes silent bugs:

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `selectionMode` | Determines `value` and `onValueChange` types. `"single"` = `Date \| null`, `"range"` = `DateRange \| null`, `"multiple"` = `Date[] \| null`. |
| `showPresets` | Only shows presets panel if `true`. Uses built-in presets unless `presets` is provided. |
| `presets` | Must match the mode. Single presets return `Date`, range presets return `DateRange`, multiple return `Date[]`. |
| `markers` | Only visible when `showMarkerIndicator` is `true` (default). Tooltips require `showMarkerTooltip`. |
| `clearable` | Shows the clear button in the trigger when a value is set. Defaults to `true`. |
| `open` + `onOpenChange` | Controlled open state -- both are needed together. |
| `outsideDaysSelectable` | Only works when `showOutsideDays` is `true` (default). |
| `dropdownSide` | Set to `"top"` or `"bottom"`. Use `forceDropdownSide` to prevent auto-flipping. |

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

#### Root element
- `data-disabled` -- when picker is disabled
- `data-error` -- when error state is active
- `data-open` -- when calendar is open
- `data-loading` -- when loading state is active
- `data-valid` -- when success state is active

#### Trigger
- `data-disabled`, `data-error`, `data-valid`, `data-open` -- as on the root
- `data-loading` -- while `loading`: the trigger is disabled, dims, and shows a spinner in place of the calendar icon
- `data-reduce-motion` -- on that spinner, while reduced motion is in force

#### Day cells
- `data-selected` -- selected day (accent fill; a range's start and end too)
- `data-today` -- today's date (underlined by default)
- `data-disabled` -- disabled day
- `data-outside` -- day outside current month (tertiary text)
- `data-range` -- `"start"`, `"middle"` or `"end"` of a selected range; the middle paints accent text
- `data-range-start` -- first day of range (companion of `data-range="start"`)
- `data-range-end` -- last day of range (companion of `data-range="end"`)
- `data-in-range` -- day within selected range (companion of `data-range`)
- `data-highlighted` -- keyboard-focused day
- `data-marked` -- day with a marker
- `data-marker-type` -- marker type string (e.g. `"meeting"`, `"deadline"`)

#### Preset buttons
- `data-active` -- the preset matching the current value; it takes the accent fill
- `data-state="active"` -- the same preset, for a selector keyed to `data-state`

#### Elsewhere
- `data-side` -- on the calendar's surface, the side it was placed on after any flip
- `data-invalid` -- on the error message

**DOM nesting:** root `<div>` -> trigger `<button>` -> calendar popover `<div>` -> month grid -> day grid `<div role="grid">`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from DatePicker.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `selectionMode` | `"single"` \| `"range"` \| `"multiple"` | `"single"` | Selection mode: single date, date range, or multiple dates. |
| `value` | — | — | Controlled selected value. Type depends on `selectionMode`: Date \| null (single), DateRange \| null (range), Date[] \| null (multiple). |
| `onValueChange` | object | — | Callback when the selected value changes. Signature depends on `selectionMode`. |
| `onClear` | object | — | () => void — Called when the clear button is clicked. |
| `onMonthChange` | object | — | (month: Date) => void — Called when the displayed month changes. |
| `open` | boolean | — | Controlled open state of the calendar popup. |
| `defaultOpen` | boolean | `false` | Initial open state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `defaultValue` | — | — | Initial selection for uncontrolled usage. Type depends on `selectionMode`: Date \| null (single), DateRange \| null (range), Date[] \| null (multiple). Use `value` instead for controlled usage. |
| `onOpenChange` | object | — | (open: boolean) => void |
| `minDate` | object | — | Date — Earliest selectable date. |
| `maxDate` | object | — | Date — Latest selectable date. |
| `disabledDates` | object | — | Configuration for disabling specific dates. |
| `weekStartsOn` | `0` \| `1` \| `2` \| `3` \| `4` \| `5` \| `6` | `0` | First day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.). |
| `locale` | object | — | date-fns Locale object for internationalization. |
| `numberOfMonths` | number | `1` | Number of months to display simultaneously. |
| `dateFormat` | string | `"MMM d, yyyy"` | Date format string (date-fns format). |
| `showTodayIndicator` | boolean | `true` | Underlines today's date (2px, in the cell's text colour) and sets `data-today` on its cell, so the mark stays visible when today is also selected, in a range, focused or disabled. Restyle it with a `data-[today]:` variant in `classes.item`. Today's cell carries `aria-current="date"` either way. |
| `showTodayButton` | boolean | `false` | Shows a 'Today' button in the calendar footer. |
| `todayAction` | boolean | `false` | Whether clicking 'Today' selects today's date. |
| `showWeekNumbers` | boolean | `false` | Shows week numbers in the calendar. |
| `showOutsideDays` | boolean | `true` | Shows days from adjacent months. |
| `outsideDaysSelectable` | boolean | `true` | Whether outside days can be selected. |
| `fixedWeeks` | boolean | `false` | Always shows 6 weeks per month for consistent height. |
| `showPresets` | boolean | `false` | Shows preset date selection buttons. |
| `presets` | array | — | Array of date presets. |
| `markers` | array | — | Array of date markers to display on the calendar. |
| `showMarkerIndicator` | boolean | `true` | Shows dots on marked dates. |
| `showMarkerTooltip` | boolean | `true` | Shows tooltips on marked dates. |
| `id` | string | — | HTML id attribute. |
| `name` | string | — | Form field name. Submits the selection through hidden inputs: a single date as `YYYY-MM-DD`; a range as one ISO 8601 interval, `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD`, with an unpicked side left empty; multiple dates as one entry per date under this name, in date order. With nothing selected, single and range submit `""` and multiple submits no entry, as a native `<select multiple>` does. Nothing is submitted while disabled. |
| `placeholder` | string | — | Placeholder text for the trigger input. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the date picker. |
| `error` | boolean | `false` | Displays error state. |
| `errorMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Error message. |
| `label` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Label above the trigger. |
| `description` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Description text. |
| `success` | boolean | `false` | Displays success state. |
| `successMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Success message. |
| `loading` | boolean | `false` | Shows loading state. |
| `clearable` | boolean | `true` | Shows a clear button. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Marks the field as required. |
| `fullWidth` | boolean | `false` | Stretches the date picker to fill its container width. |
| `showCalendarIcon` | boolean | `true` | Shows the calendar icon in the trigger. |
| `calendarIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom calendar icon. |
| `clearIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom clear icon. |
| `prevMonthIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom previous month icon. |
| `nextMonthIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom next month icon. |
| `prevYearIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom previous year icon. |
| `nextYearIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom next year icon. |
| `todayIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Custom today button icon. |
| `monthDropdownSelectedIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Icon for selected month in dropdown. |
| `yearDropdownSelectedIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Icon for selected year in dropdown. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for date picker sub-elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `portalContainer` | object | — | HTMLElement \| null — Portal container for the calendar popup. |
| `lockScroll` | boolean | `false` | Locks body scroll when the calendar is open. |
| `dropdownZIndex` | number | `50` | Z-index of the calendar popup. |
| `dropdownSide` | `"top"` \| `"bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Vertical placement of the calendar popup. |
| `forceDropdownSide` | boolean | `false` | Locks the calendar to the specified dropdownSide without auto-flipping. |
| `dropdownOffset` | number | `4` | Gap in pixels between trigger and calendar popup. |
| `keepMounted` | boolean | `false` | Keep the calendar DOM mounted when closed. |
| `reduceMotion` | boolean \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting. |

### Styling Guide

> **A plain utility replaces the library's for that property, in every state.**
> `classes={{ slot: "text-red-500" }}` drops the library's `hover:text-…` and
> `data-[state=…]:text-…` on that slot as well — otherwise they would sit beside
> your class and win in their own state, leaving your override in the DOM and
> inert. Pass your own variant to keep one: `"text-red-500 hover:text-red-400"`.
> A variant YOU pass is never dropped.

#### How class merging works

The component has three styling modes:

1. **Default** (`unstyled=false`, no `classes`): Uses `DEFAULT_DATEPICKER_CLASSES` -- fully styled with dark mode support.
2. **Partial override** (`unstyled=false`, partial `classes`) — your classes compose with that slot's defaults; slots you don't name keep theirs.

**A plain utility of yours wins over every default in its group on that slot, states included.**
`classes={{ control: "bg-green-500" }}` paints green in every state, where a default
`data-[state=checked]:` background would otherwise keep winning. To restyle one state only,
pass that state's own variant (`data-[state=checked]:bg-green-500`). Defaults in other groups stay.

3. **Unstyled** (`unstyled=true`): All slots start as empty strings. You must provide everything via `classes`.

```tsx
// Adds to the trigger's default classes; a conflicting utility replaces its default:
<DatePicker classes={{ trigger: "my-custom-trigger" }} />

// The other slots (content, item, etc.) still use their defaults.
```

```tsx
// `item` is the day cell. Its defaults paint each state with a variant:
//   data-[selected]       accent fill, on-accent text (a range's ends are selected too)
//   data-[range=middle]   accent text
//   data-[outside]        tertiary text (the adjacent month)
//   data-[today]          a 2px underline in the cell's text colour
//   data-[disabled]       50% opacity
//   :focus                the focus ring
// Your classes compose with these, so restyle one state with its own variant:
<DatePicker
  classes={{
    item: "data-[today]:decoration-cl-accent data-[selected]:bg-emerald-600",
  }}
/>
```

#### Slot overview

| "I want to change..." | Slot to use | Notes |
|------------------------|-------------|-------|
| Trigger button appearance | `trigger` | The clickable input area |
| Trigger text | `input` | Text display inside trigger |
| Calendar/clear icons | `icon`, `clearTrigger` | Icons inside trigger |
| Label, description, error text | `label`, `description`, `message`, `message` | Form field elements |
| Calendar popover | `content` | Outer container of calendar |
| Month/year navigation | `header`, `row`, `navTrigger` | Calendar header area |
| Month/year dropdowns | `monthSelect`, `yearSelect`, `subContent`, `subItem` | Month/year selectors — the selected option carries `data-selected` |
| Weekday headers | `listHeader`, `weekday` | Day-of-week labels |
| Day cells | `item` | Individual calendar days |
| Range highlighting | `dayRangeStart`, `dayRangeEnd`, `dayRangeMiddle` | Range mode visual |
| Keyboard focus | — | The focused day carries `data-highlighted` |
| Marked days | `markerIndicator` | Marker visuals |
| Week numbers | `weekNumber` | Week number column |
| Presets | `presetGroup`, `presetTrigger` | Preset buttons panel |
| Footer / today button | `footer`, `todayTrigger` | Calendar footer |
| Multi-month layout | `listRow`, `list` | Side-by-side months |

#### Dark mode

Default classes use Tailwind `dark:` prefix. When overriding, always provide both light and dark variants:

```tsx
<DatePicker classes={{
  trigger: "bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100",
  item: "data-selected:bg-indigo-600 data-selected:text-white dark:data-selected:bg-indigo-500",
}} />
```

#### Styling via data attributes

```tsx
// Tailwind arbitrary variants on item cells:
<DatePicker classes={{
  item: "[&[data-selected]]:bg-purple-600 [&[data-today]]:ring-purple-500 [&[data-disabled]]:opacity-30",
}} />
```

Or in plain CSS:

```css
[data-selected] { background-color: #7c3aed; color: white; }
[data-today] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8b5cf6; }
[data-marker-type="deadline"] { font-weight: bold; }
```

---

### Patterns

#### Range selection

```tsx
const [range, setRange] = useState<DateRange | null>(null);

<DatePicker
  selectionMode="range"
  value={range}
  onValueChange={(r) => setRange(r)}
  placeholder="Start date - End date"
  clearable
/>
```

#### Multiple dates

```tsx
const [dates, setDates] = useState<Date[] | null>(null);

<DatePicker
  selectionMode="multiple"
  value={dates}
  onValueChange={(d) => setDates(d)}
  placeholder="Pick multiple dates..."
  clearable
/>
```

#### With presets

```tsx
<DatePicker
  selectionMode="range"
  value={range}
  onValueChange={(r) => setRange(r)}
  showPresets
/>
```

#### Custom presets

```tsx
const presets = [
  { label: "Today", getValue: () => new Date() },
  { label: "Yesterday", getValue: () => subDays(new Date(), 1) },
  { label: "Start of Month", getValue: () => startOfMonth(new Date()) },
];

<DatePicker presets={presets} showPresets />
```

#### With markers

```tsx
const markers = [
  { date: addDays(new Date(), 2), label: "Meeting", type: "meeting", color: "#6366f1" },
  { date: addDays(new Date(), 5), label: "Deadline", description: "Project due", color: "#ef4444" },
];

<DatePicker markers={markers} showMarkerIndicator showMarkerTooltip />
```

#### Controlled open state

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<DatePicker open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} />
```

#### Disabled dates

```tsx
<DatePicker
  disabledDates={{
    disablePast: true,
    daysOfWeek: [0, 6], // disable weekends
    dates: [specificDate],
    custom: (date) => date.getDate() === 13,
  }}
/>
```

#### Locale support

```tsx
import { fr } from "date-fns/locale";

<DatePicker locale={fr} weekStartsOn={1} dateFormat="d MMMM yyyy" />
```

#### Multiple months

```tsx
<DatePicker selectionMode="range" numberOfMonths={2} />
```

#### Form field with validation

```tsx
<DatePicker
  label="Start date"
  description="When should the project begin?"
  required
  error={!date}
  errorMessage="Please select a date"
/>
```

---

### Forms

- **Submitted value.** With `name`, it submits the formats in the `name` row above: `YYYY-MM-DD` for a single date, one `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD` interval for a range, one entry per date (sorted) for multiple dates, and, with nothing picked, an empty string for a single date or a range and no entry at all for multiple dates, as a native `<select multiple>` does.
- **Reset.** A form reset — a `type="reset"` button or `form.reset()` — restores an uncontrolled selection to `defaultValue` (or no date), and the submitted value with it. Like a native input it fires no change callback: `onValueChange` is not called. A controlled DatePicker is left alone: it keeps the `value` you pass and calls nothing, as a controlled React `<input>` does. Reset your own state in the form's `onReset` if you want the field cleared.
- **Required.** An empty `required` DatePicker blocks the form's submit, and the browser's validation moves focus to the trigger. Multiple-date mode needs at least one date. The field shows an error state only when you pass `error` and `errorMessage`.
- **Disabled.** A disabled DatePicker submits nothing.

### Keyboard Interactions

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the calendar from the trigger, and selects the focused day. |
| `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` | Moves a day. `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` move a week. Disabled days are stepped over rather than focused. |
| `Home`, `End` | Jumps to the start or end of the week, honouring `weekStartsOn`. |
| `PageUp`, `PageDown` | Changes month. With `Shift`, changes year. |
| `Escape` | Closes the calendar and returns focus to the trigger. Always: there is no prop to turn it off, because the APG date picker dialog pattern requires Escape to close the calendar. |
| `Tab` | Cycles within the panel, which is `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and traps focus in both directions. |

---

### Ref API

The ref lands on the trigger, the `<button role="combobox">` a keyboard user tabs to, so `ref.current.focus()` focuses the field — which is what a form library calls on the first invalid field.

```tsx
const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
<DatePicker ref={ref} label="Date" />
// ref.current is the trigger <button>
```

---

## Drawer

> A sliding panel overlay with focus trapping, scroll lock, swipe-to-close, snap points, stacked drawer support, and keyboard navigation.

**Category:** Overlay
**Keywords:** drawer, sidebar, panel, slide-out, sheet, bottom sheet, overlay, modal panel

### Import

```tsx
import { Drawer, DrawerHeader, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter, DrawerCloseButton } from "@chumlab/ui/drawer";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { Drawer, DrawerHeader, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter, DrawerCloseButton } from "@chumlab/ui/drawer";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open Drawer</button>
      <Drawer open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DrawerHeader>
          <h2>Settings</h2>
          <DrawerCloseButton />
        </DrawerHeader>
        <DrawerBody>
          <p>Drawer content goes here.</p>
        </DrawerBody>
        <DrawerFooter>
          <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Close</button>
        </DrawerFooter>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

---

### Prop Constraints

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `side` | `"left"` (default), `"right"`, `"top"`, `"bottom"` |
| `snapPoints` | Array of percentages (0-1). Requires `swipeable={true}`. |
| `swipeable` | By touch, a `left` or `right` drawer is dragged from anywhere on it. A `top` or `bottom` sheet is dragged from its handle or its `DrawerHeader`, because its content scrolls along the axis it dismisses on. A mouse drags from the handle on every side. |
| `trapFocus` | Defaults `true` when `modal={true}`. |
| `keepMounted` | Keeps DOM alive when closed. Uses `inert` to hide. |

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

**Root:**
- `data-state="open" | "closed"` — follows `open`; the panel slides and the overlay fades on it
- `data-side="left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"` — the edge the drawer comes from

**Parts** (each a marker on its element, for a selector or a test; none of them is a state):
- `data-drawer-overlay` — the backdrop, when `modal`
- `data-drawer-panel` — the `role="dialog"` panel; it carries `data-side` too
- `data-drawer-handle` — the drag handle, when `swipeable`
- `data-drawer-header`, `data-drawer-body`, `data-drawer-footer` — the `DrawerHeader`, `DrawerBody` and `DrawerFooter` you place
- `data-drawer-close` — the `DrawerCloseButton`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Drawer.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `open` | boolean | — | Controlled open state. |
| `defaultOpen` | boolean | `false` | Initial open state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onOpenChange` | object | — | (open: boolean) => void — Callback when the drawer's open state changes. |
| `zIndex` | number | `9999` | Z-index of the drawer overlay and panel. |
| `children` | object | — | React.ReactNode — Drawer content (DrawerHeader, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter). |
| `side` | `"left"` \| `"right"` \| `"top"` \| `"bottom"` | `"left"` | The edge the drawer slides in from. |
| `size` | string | `"300px"` | CSS size value for the drawer panel (width for left/right, height for top/bottom). |
| `overlayColor` | string | `"black"` | Background color of the overlay. |
| `overlayOpacity` | number | `0.32` | How strongly overlayColor tints the page (0-1), applied as the background's alpha; the overlay element stays opaque so overlayBlur is not diluted. |
| `overlayBlur` | number | `0` | Backdrop blur in pixels for the overlay. |
| `animationDuration` | number | `300` | Open and close animation length, in milliseconds. |
| `lockScroll` | boolean | `true` | Locks body scroll when the drawer is open. |
| `closeOnOverlayClick` | boolean | `true` | Closes the drawer when the overlay is clicked. |
| `closeOnEscape` | boolean | `true` | Enables closing via the Escape key. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for drawer sub-elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `reduceMotion` | boolean \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting. |
| `trapFocus` | boolean | `true` | Traps keyboard focus within the drawer. |
| `restoreFocus` | boolean | `true` | Restores focus to the previously focused element when the drawer closes. |
| `portalContainer` | object | — | HTMLElement \| null — Portal container for the drawer. |
| `initialFocus` | object | — | RefObject<HTMLElement> — Element to receive focus when the drawer opens. |
| `onTransitionEnd` | object | — | (open: boolean) => void — Called when the open/close transition completes. |
| `keepMounted` | boolean | `false` | Keep the drawer DOM mounted when closed. |
| `modal` | boolean | `true` | Whether the drawer behaves as a modal dialog. |
| `swipeable` | boolean | `false` | Enables swipe-to-close gesture. |
| `swipeThreshold` | number | `0.4` | How far a swipe has to travel to close the drawer, as a fraction of the panel's size along the swipe (0.4 is 40% of its height for a top or bottom sheet, of its width for a side drawer). A fast enough fling closes it at any distance. |
| `snapPoints` | array | — | Array of snap point positions (0-1) for the drawer panel. |
| `snapPointIndex` | number | — | Controlled index into `snapPoints`. Pairs with `defaultSnapPointIndex` and `onSnapPointIndexChange`. |
| `defaultSnapPointIndex` | number | `0` | Initial snap point index for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onSnapPointIndexChange` | object | — | (index: number) => void — Called when the active snap point changes. |

### Keyboard Interactions

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Escape` | Closes the drawer, unless `closeOnEscape={false}`. |
| `Tab` | Cycles focus inside the panel while `trapFocus` is on, and never reaches the page behind it. |

---

---

## Dropdown

> A single-select dropdown (combobox) with portal rendering, keyboard navigation, async loading, and full style customization.

**Category:** Form
**Keywords:** dropdown, select, combobox, listbox, picker, option, menu, form control, single select

### Import

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from "@chumlab/ui/dropdown";
import type { DropdownOption } from "@chumlab/ui/dropdown";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Dropdown } from "@chumlab/ui/dropdown";

const options = [
  { value: "apple", label: "Apple" },
  { value: "banana", label: "Banana" },
  { value: "cherry", label: "Cherry" },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <Dropdown
      options={options}
      value={value}
      onValueChange={(v) => setValue(v)}
      placeholder="Select a fruit..."
    />
  );
}
```

---

### Prop Constraints (critical for correct usage)

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `value` + `defaultValue` | Never combine. Use one or the other. |
| `value` requires `onValueChange` | Controlled mode — both needed together. |
| `open` requires `onOpenChange` | Controlled open state — both needed together. |
| `clearable` | Only works when a value is selected. Adds a clear button and allows deselect via click. |
| `loadOptions` | Requires `loadOnOpen={true}` to trigger. Returns `Promise<DropdownOption[]>`. |
| `loadOnOpen` | Only works when `loadOptions` is provided. |
| `forceDropdownSide` | Only meaningful with `dropdownSide`. Disables auto-flip. |
| `lockScroll` | Prevents body scroll while open. Default: `false`. |
| `renderTrigger` | `renderTrigger(triggerProps, state)` replaces the default `<button>`. Spread `triggerProps` onto a `<button>`: it is exactly what the default trigger renders, ref and `type="button"` included. Draw from `state` (`isOpen`, `selectedOption`, `placeholder`), which never reaches the DOM. |
| `name` | Renders a hidden `<input>` for native form submission. |

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

**Root element:**
- `data-disabled` — when `disabled={true}`
- `data-error` — when `error={true}`
- `data-open` — when dropdown is open
- `data-full-width` — when `fullWidth={true}`
- `data-valid` — when `success={true}`

**Trigger element:**
- `data-disabled`, `data-error`, `data-open` — mirrors root
- `data-placeholder` — when no option is selected; the placeholder text is tertiary

**Content (portal):**
- `data-state="open|closed"`
- `data-position="top|bottom"` — actual rendered position
- `data-dropdown-id` — unique ID for click-outside detection
- `data-side` — on the surface, the side it was placed on after any flip

**Options:**
- `data-selected`, `data-highlighted`, `data-disabled`, `data-value`

**Messages:** `data-invalid` on the error message

**DOM nesting:** `root > label? + description? + wrapper > trigger + content(portal) > optionList > option*`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Dropdown.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `options` | array | `[]` | List of selectable options. |
| `value` | string \| null | — | Controlled selected value. |
| `defaultValue` | string | — | Initial selected value for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onValueChange` | object | — | (value: string \| null, option: DropdownOption \| null) => void - Fires when the selected value changes. |
| `open` | boolean | — | Controlled open state. |
| `defaultOpen` | boolean | — | Whether the dropdown is initially open (uncontrolled). |
| `onOpenChange` | object | — | (open: boolean) => void - Fires when the open state changes. |
| `id` | string | — | HTML id attribute for the trigger element. |
| `name` | string | — | Form field name for the hidden input. |
| `placeholder` | object | `"Select an option"` | React.ReactNode - Content displayed when no option is selected. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the dropdown. |
| `error` | boolean | `false` | Displays the dropdown in an error state. |
| `errorMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the dropdown. |
| `label` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the dropdown. |
| `description` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Description text rendered below the label. |
| `success` | boolean | `false` | Displays the dropdown in a success state. |
| `successMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the dropdown. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Marks the field as required. |
| `clearable` | boolean | `false` | Shows a clear button to deselect the current value. |
| `emptyContent` | object | `"No options available"` | React.ReactNode - Content shown when no options are available. |
| `showChevron` | boolean | `true` | Whether to show the chevron icon in the trigger. |
| `showSelectedIcon` | boolean | `true` | Whether to show a check icon next to the selected option. |
| `selectedIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Custom icon for the selected option indicator. |
| `fullWidth` | boolean | `false` | Makes the dropdown span the full width of its container. |
| `loading` | boolean | — | Shows a loading/shimmer state. |
| `loadOptions` | object | — | () => Promise<DropdownOption[]> - Async function to load options. Requires `loadOnOpen`; alone it never fires. |
| `loadOnOpen` | boolean | `false` | When true, calls loadOptions each time the dropdown opens. Requires `loadOptions`; alone it has nothing to load. |
| `onLoadError` | object | — | (error: unknown) => void - Called when async option loading fails. |
| `shimmerCount` | number | `5` | Number of shimmer placeholder items shown during loading. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for dropdown sub-elements. |
| `className` | string | — | Additional CSS class for the root element. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the root element. |
| `keepMounted` | boolean | `false` | Keeps the dropdown DOM mounted when closed. |
| `portalContainer` | object | — | HTMLElement \| null - Portal target for the dropdown popup. |
| `lockScroll` | boolean | `false` | Locks body scroll while the dropdown is open. |
| `dropdownSide` | `"top"` \| `"bottom"` | `"bottom"` | Vertical placement of the dropdown relative to the trigger. |
| `forceDropdownSide` | boolean | `false` | Locks the dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping. |
| `dropdownZIndex` | number | `50` | Z-index of the dropdown popup. |
| `dropdownOffset` | number | `4` | Gap in pixels between trigger and dropdown popup. |
| `typeaheadTimeout` | number | `500` | Timeout in milliseconds for keyboard typeahead matching. |
| `aria-label` | string | — | Accessible label for the dropdown. |
| `aria-labelledby` | string | — | Names the field by another element, and wins over `label` and `aria-label`. Lands on the trigger. |
| `aria-describedby` | string | — | Lands on the trigger, joined with the component's own error message. |
| `onBlur` | object | — | (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void - Fires when the trigger loses focus, with the native focus event. |
| `onFocus` | object | — | (event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void - Fires when the trigger takes focus, with the native focus event. |
| `onKeyDown` | object | — | (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void - Fires on keydown events. |
| `renderTrigger` | object | — | (triggerProps: DropdownTriggerRenderProps, state: DropdownTriggerState) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the trigger element. Spread triggerProps onto a <button>; draw from state (isOpen, selectedOption, placeholder). |
| `chevronIcon` | object | — | ReactNode — Replaces the trigger's chevron. Rendered inside a box carrying `classes.icon`, which turns it over while the menu is open. |
| `clearIcon` | object | — | ReactNode — Replaces the clear button's glyph. Rendered as given. |
| `loadingContent` | object | `"Loading..."` | React.ReactNode - Text shown during async loading. |

### Styling Guide

> **A plain utility replaces the library's for that property, in every state.**
> `classes={{ slot: "text-red-500" }}` drops the library's `hover:text-…` and
> `data-[state=…]:text-…` on that slot as well — otherwise they would sit beside
> your class and win in their own state, leaving your override in the DOM and
> inert. Pass your own variant to keep one: `"text-red-500 hover:text-red-400"`.
> A variant YOU pass is never dropped.

#### How class merging works

1. **Default** (no `classes`, no `unstyled`) — uses built-in Tailwind classes with dark mode support
2. **Partial override** (`classes={{ trigger: "..." }}`) — your classes compose with that slot's defaults; slots you don't name keep theirs.

**A plain utility of yours wins over every default in its group on that slot, states included.**
`classes={{ control: "bg-green-500" }}` paints green in every state, where a default
`data-[state=checked]:` background would otherwise keep winning. To restyle one state only,
pass that state's own variant (`data-[state=checked]:bg-green-500`). Defaults in other groups stay.

3. **Unstyled** (`unstyled={true}`) — all slots empty, you provide everything via `classes`

```tsx
// `item` carries the base AND 3 state variants. Overriding it
// replaces all of them, so write them together:
<Dropdown
  classes={{
    item:
      "rounded-cl-md px-2 py-1 " +           // base
      "data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[disabled]:cursor-not-allowed " +
      "data-[highlighted]:bg-cl-bg-hover " +
      "data-[selected]:bg-cl-accent/15 data-[selected]:text-cl-accent ",
  }}
/>

// Passing only `item: "data-[disabled]:…"` drops the base and the other
// 2 states.
```

#### Slot → visual mapping

```
root
├── label
├── description
└── control (relative container)
    ├── trigger (button)
    │   ├── value (selected value or placeholder)
    │   └── icon (icon)
    ├── clearTrigger (button, absolute positioned)
    └── content (portal → fixed position)
        └── list (scrollable)
            └── item (repeated)
                ├── label/content
                └── itemIndicator (when selected)
    empty (when empty)
    loading / loadingItem (when loading)
message
message
```

| "I want to change..." | Slot | Notes |
|------------------------|------|-------|
| Trigger button style | `trigger` | Includes border, bg, focus ring |
| Selected text appearance | `value` | Has `truncate` by default |
| Popup container | `content` | Border, shadow, bg |
| Option row | `item` | Hover/cursor styles |
| Selected option highlight |  | Applied on top of `item` |
| Keyboard-focused option |  | Applied on top of `item` |
| Disabled option | `optionDisabled` | Includes `pointer-events-none` |
| Dropdown arrow icon | `icon` | Size, color, transition |
| Check mark on selected | `itemIndicator` | Size, color |
| Clear/X button | `clearTrigger` | Absolutely positioned |
| Empty state | `empty` | Centered text |
| Label text | `label` | Font, color, spacing |
| Error message | `message` | Below dropdown |
| Success message | `message` | Below dropdown |

#### Dark mode

Defaults use Tailwind `dark:` variants, activated by `<html class="dark">`. When overriding a slot, always provide both light and dark variants:

```tsx
classes={{ trigger: "bg-white dark:bg-gray-900 text-black dark:text-white ..." }}
```

#### Styling via data attributes

```css
/* Tailwind arbitrary variant */
<Dropdown classes={{ trigger: "data-[open]:ring-2 data-[message]:border-red-500" }} />

/* Plain CSS */
[data-state="open"] { ... }
[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; }
```

#### Complete themed example (Stripe-style)

```tsx
<Dropdown
  unstyled
  options={options}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  classes={{
    trigger: "flex items-center justify-between w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md bg-white text-gray-900 shadow-sm hover:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:border-gray-600 dark:text-white",
    value: "flex-1 text-left truncate",
    content: "rounded-md shadow-lg bg-white border border-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:border-gray-700",
    list: "max-h-60 overflow-y-auto py-1",
    item: "flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:text-gray-200 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 cursor-pointer data-selected:bg-indigo-50 data-selected:text-indigo-700 dark:data-selected:bg-indigo-900/30 dark:data-selected:text-indigo-300 data-highlighted:bg-gray-100 dark:data-highlighted:bg-gray-700",
    itemIndicator: "w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    icon: "w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200",
  }}
/>
```

---

### Patterns

#### Controlled state

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = useState<string | null>(null);
<Dropdown options={options} value={value} onValueChange={(v) => setValue(v)} />
```

#### Async loading on open

```tsx
<Dropdown
  loadOnOpen
  loadOptions={async () => {
    const res = await fetch("/api/options");
    return res.json();
  }}
  onLoadError={(err) => console.message(err)}
  placeholder="Click to load..."
/>
```

#### With label, error, and form name

```tsx
<Dropdown
  label="Country"
  required
  name="country"
  error={!value}
  errorMessage="Please select a country"
  options={countries}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
/>
```

#### Custom trigger

```tsx
<Dropdown
  options={options}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  renderTrigger={(triggerProps, { selectedOption, placeholder }) => (
    <button {...triggerProps} className="custom-trigger">
      {selectedOption?.label ?? placeholder}
    </button>
  )}
/>
```

---

### Forms

- **Submitted value.** With `name`, it submits one entry, the selected option's `value`, or an empty string when nothing is selected.
- **Reset.** A form reset — a `type="reset"` button or `form.reset()` — restores an uncontrolled selection to `defaultValue` (or no selection), and the submitted value with it. Like a native input it fires no change callback: `onValueChange` is not called. A controlled Dropdown is left alone: it keeps the `value` you pass and calls nothing, as a controlled React `<input>` does. Reset your own state in the form's `onReset` if you want the field cleared.
- **Required.** An empty `required` Dropdown blocks the form's submit, and the browser's validation moves focus to the trigger. The field shows an error state only when you pass `error` and `errorMessage`.
- **Disabled.** A disabled Dropdown submits nothing, as a disabled native control doesn't.

### Keyboard Interactions

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the menu from the trigger, and selects the focused option. |
| `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp` | Moves between options, opening the menu first if it is closed. |
| `Home`, `End` | Jumps to the first or last option. |
| `Escape` | Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger. Always: there is no prop to turn it off, because the APG combobox pattern requires Escape to close the popup. |
| `Tab` | Closes the menu and moves focus on. |
| `Backspace`, `Delete` | Clears the selection when the trigger has focus and `clearable` is set. |
| Printable characters | Type-ahead within `typeaheadTimeout` of the last keystroke. |

---

### Ref API

The ref lands on the trigger, the `<button role="combobox">` a keyboard user tabs to, so `ref.current.focus()` focuses the field — which is what a form library calls on the first invalid field. With `renderTrigger`, it is the element your trigger attaches `triggerProps.ref` to.

```tsx
const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
<Dropdown ref={ref} options={options} />
// ref.current is the trigger <button>
```

---

## Input

> A production-grade text input with labels, icons, prefix/suffix, clearable, character count, validation states, and full form integration.

**Category:** Form
**Keywords:** input, text input, text field, form, label, validation, clearable, prefix, suffix, password

### Import

```tsx
import { Input, InputLabel } from "@chumlab/ui/input";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { Input } from "@chumlab/ui/input";

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16, maxWidth: 380 }}>
      <Input label="Full Name" placeholder="Enter your name..." />
      <Input label="Email" placeholder="you@example.com" description="We'll never share your email" />
      <Input label="Password" type="password" placeholder="Enter password..." required />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### Prop Constraints

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `onStartIconClick` | Requires `startIconAriaLabel` for accessibility |
| `onEndIconClick` | Requires `endIconAriaLabel` for accessibility |
| `showCount` | Requires `maxLength` to be set |
| `size` | Sets the control's padding and type: 28/40/52px fields, 30/42/54 with the border. Emits `data-size` as well, for CSS that wants it |
| `prefix` / `suffix` | For static text/elements. Use `startIcon`/`endIcon` for icons |
| `clearable` | Only shows clear button when input has a value |

---

### Data Attributes

- `data-size` on root — "sm", "md", "lg"
- `data-disabled` on root — when disabled
- `data-error` on root — when error state
- `data-valid` on root — when success state
- `data-readonly` on root — when readOnly
- `data-loading` on root — when loading: the field dims, takes no input, and shows a spinner
- `data-reduce-motion` on that spinner — while reduced motion is in force
- `data-invalid` on the error message
- `data-slot="input"` on the input element
- `data-slot="count"` on the character count

DOM nesting: `root > label + description + wrapper(prefix + startIcon + input + endIcon + suffix + clear + loader) + error/success + count`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Input.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the input. |
| `description` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Helper text rendered below the label. |
| `error` | boolean | `false` | Displays the input in an error state. |
| `errorMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the input. |
| `success` | boolean | `false` | Green success state for validated fields. |
| `successMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the input. |
| `size` | `"sm"` \| `"md"` \| `"lg"` | — | Sets the control's padding and type size together: a 28, 40 and 52px field, 30/42/54 with its border. Also emits data-size on the root for CSS to target; the attribute is a hook beside the sizing, not the sizing itself. |
| `prefix` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Inline text or element rendered before the input (e.g. '$', 'https://'). |
| `suffix` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Inline text or element rendered after the input (e.g. 'USD', '.com'). |
| `startIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Icon rendered before the input. Becomes a button when onStartIconClick is provided. |
| `endIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Icon rendered after the input. Becomes a button when onEndIconClick is provided. |
| `onStartIconClick` | object | — | (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void - Makes startIcon a clickable button, called with the native click event. Requires startIconAriaLabel for accessibility. |
| `onEndIconClick` | object | — | (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void - Makes endIcon a clickable button, called with the native click event. Requires endIconAriaLabel for accessibility. |
| `startIconAriaLabel` | string | — | Accessible label for startIcon when it is clickable. Required with onStartIconClick. |
| `endIconAriaLabel` | string | — | Accessible label for endIcon when it is clickable. Required with onEndIconClick. |
| `onValueChange` | object | — | (value: string) => void - Fires with the current string value when the value changes. |
| `clearable` | boolean | `false` | Show a built-in clear button when the input has a value. |
| `onClear` | object | — | () => void - Callback when the clear button is clicked. |
| `showCount` | boolean | `false` | Show character count (requires maxLength to be set). |
| `loading` | boolean | `false` | Shows a loading spinner inside the input. |
| `loader` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Custom loader element to replace the default spinner. |
| `loaderSize` | number | `16` | Size of the default CircularLoader in pixels. Ignored when a custom loader prop is provided. |
| `fullWidth` | boolean | `false` | Makes the input span the full width of its container. |
| `className` | string | — | CSS class for the root container element. |
| `classes` | object | — | Slot-based class overrides for internal elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | When true, all default classes are removed so you can style from scratch. |

### Sub-component Props

Generated from the types by `scripts/build-subcomponent-schemas.mjs`.

#### InputLabel

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | The label's content. |
| `required` | `boolean \| undefined` | Marks the field required and draws the required indicator. |
| `htmlFor` | `string \| undefined` | The id of the control this labels. Set automatically when the label is rendered by the field. |
| `className` | `string \| undefined` | Additional classes for the root element. |

---

### Styling Guide

> **A plain utility replaces the library's for that property, in every state.**
> `classes={{ slot: "text-red-500" }}` drops the library's `hover:text-…` and
> `data-[state=…]:text-…` on that slot as well — otherwise they would sit beside
> your class and win in their own state, leaving your override in the DOM and
> inert. Pass your own variant to keep one: `"text-red-500 hover:text-red-400"`.
> A variant YOU pass is never dropped.

A restyle that drops the box, such as an underline, must also replace the focus ring: pass `focus-within:ring-0` and mark focus on the edge you keep, or the default `focus-within:ring-2` survives the merge and the field focuses as a box.

#### How class merging works

1. **Default** — uses `DEFAULT_INPUT_CLASSES` with dark mode, focus ring, rounded corners
2. **Partial override** — your classes compose with that slot's defaults; slots you don't name keep theirs.

**A plain utility of yours wins over every default in its group on that slot, states included.**
`classes={{ control: "bg-green-500" }}` paints green in every state, where a default
`data-[state=checked]:` background would otherwise keep winning. To restyle one state only,
pass that state's own variant (`data-[state=checked]:bg-green-500`). Defaults in other groups stay.

3. **Unstyled** — all slots empty

#### Slot → visual mapping

```
root (flex flex-col)
├── label
├── description
├── control (border, focus ring, flex row)
│   ├── prefix
│   ├── startIcon
│   ├── input
│   ├── endIcon
│   ├── suffix
│   ├── clear button
│   └── loader
├── message / message
└── count
```

| "I want to change..." | Slot | Notes |
|------------------------|------|-------|
| Border/focus ring | `control` | Contains all input chrome |
| Input text | `input` | Font, color, placeholder |
| Label style | `label` | Font weight, size, color |
| Error text | `message` | Color, icon |
| The whole field and its labelling | `root` | The outer wrapper; `fullWidth` adds `w-full` here |
| The character counter | `count` | Shown under the field when `showCount` is set |

#### Dark mode

Defaults include `dark:` variants for all slots. When overriding, provide both:

```tsx
classes={{ control: "border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-900" }}
```

---

### Patterns

#### Password with toggle

```tsx
const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
<Input
  type={show ? "text" : "password"}
  label="Password"
  endIcon={show ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
  onEndIconClick={() => setShow(!show)}
  endIconAriaLabel={show ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
/>
```

#### With validation

```tsx
<Input
  label="Email"
  error={!isValid}
  errorMessage="Please enter a valid email"
  success={isValid}
  successMessage="Looks good!"
/>
```

---

### Forms

- **Submitted value.** With `name`, it submits the text, from the native input.
- **Reset.** A form reset — a `type="reset"` button or `form.reset()` — restores an uncontrolled input to `defaultValue` (or empty), and the submitted value with it. Like a native input it fires no change callback: `onValueChange` is not called. A controlled Input is left alone: it keeps the `value` you pass and calls nothing, as a controlled React `<input>` does. Reset your own state in the form's `onReset` if you want the field cleared.
- **Required.** An empty `required` Input blocks the form's submit and the browser focuses it. The field shows an error state only when you pass `error` and `errorMessage`.

### Keyboard Interactions

A native `<input>`: the browser owns text entry, selection and the clear affordance.

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the field. `disabled` removes it from the tab order; `readOnly` does not. |

---

## InternationalPhoneInput

> Phone number input with country code selection, automatic formatting, paste detection, copy formats, and full style customization.

**Category:** Form
**Keywords:** phone, telephone, international, country code, dial code, phone input, phone number, country selector, paste detection, copy format, e164, validation, formatting

### Import

```tsx
import { InternationalPhoneInput } from "@chumlab/ui/international-phone-input";
import type { PhoneNumberData, CountryOption } from "@chumlab/ui/international-phone-input";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { InternationalPhoneInput } from "@chumlab/ui/international-phone-input";
import type { PhoneNumberData } from "@chumlab/ui/international-phone-input";

export default function Example() {
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState<PhoneNumberData | undefined>();
  return (
    <InternationalPhoneInput
      label="Phone Number"
      value={phone}
      onValueChange={setPhone}
      placeholder="Enter phone number"
    />
  );
}
```

---

### Prop Constraints (critical for correct usage)

| Prop | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| `value` + `defaultValue` | Never combine. Use one or the other. |
| `value` requires `onValueChange` | Controlled mode — both needed together. |
| `clearable` | Only shows clear button when phone input has content and not disabled/readOnly. |
| `pasteDetection` | Must be `true` for `onPasteDetect` to fire. |
| `copyFormat` | Only affects Ctrl+C behavior. Does not change display format. |
| `validateOnBlur` | When `true` (default), shows validation error on blur. Set `false` to disable. |
| `validationMessage` | Overrides the built-in "Please enter a valid phone number" message. |
| `validate` | Authoritative custom validator. Receives the full `PhoneNumberData` (incl. built-in `isValid` and E.164 `fullNumber`); its verdict overrides the built-in for both the emitted `isValid` and the blur error. Return `boolean` or `{ valid, message }`. Compose via `data.isValid && myCheck(data)`. For real number validation, use the opt-in `createLibphonenumberValidator(opts?)` from `@chumlab/ui/phone-validators` — `opts.mode` (`"isValid"` default \| `"isPossible"`), `opts.mobileOnly` (default `false`; when `true`, rejects CONFIRMED fixed-line numbers like `+91 1234567890` — accepts `MOBILE` and `FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE`, so US and other regions that can't disambiguate still pass, which is what SMS/OTP flows want), `opts.message`. Backed by the `/max` metadata. |
| `formatPatterns` | Merged over the built-in patterns: a matching key overrides that pattern, new keys are added. Keyed by pattern name. |
| `lengthRules` | Merged over the built-in rules: a matching country key overrides that country's min/max, new keys are added. Keyed by country code (uppercase). |
| `forceDropdownSide` | Only meaningful with `dropdownSide`. Disables auto-flip. |
| `lockScroll` | Prevents body scroll while country dropdown is open. Default: `false`. |
| `renderCountryOption` | Replaces default country option rendering in the dropdown list. |
| `renderSelectedCountry` | Replaces default selected country rendering in the trigger. |
| `name` | Renders two hidden inputs: `{name}` (full number) and `{name}_country` (country code). |

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

**Root (`data-slot="root"`):**
- `data-disabled` — when `disabled={true}`
- `data-error` — when `error={true}` or validation fails
- `data-valid` — when `success={true}` (without error)
- `data-readonly` — when `readOnly={true}`
- `data-full-width` — when `fullWidth={true}`
- `data-loading` — when `loading={true}`

**Wrapper (`data-slot="wrapper"`, the `role="group"` holding the country select and the number):**
- `data-disabled` — when `disabled`; the group dims
- `data-loading` — when `loading`: the group dims and takes no pointer input, the number input is disabled, and a spinner shows after it
- `data-reduce-motion` — on that spinner, while reduced motion is in force

**Input (`data-slot="input"`):**
- `data-disabled`, `data-error`, `data-valid`, `data-readonly` — mirrors root
- `data-readonly` paints a dashed border, so a number that can be read but not changed does not look like one waiting for input

**Country select** (the embedded `SearchableDropdown`; its own docs describe each):
- trigger: `data-open`, `data-placeholder`
- surface: `data-state="open" | "closed"`, `data-position`, `data-side`, `data-dropdown-id`
- options: `data-selected`, `data-highlighted`, `data-value`
- `data-code` — on each flag, the country it shows

**Messages:** `data-invalid` on the error message

**Other slots:** `data-slot="label"`, `data-slot="wrapper"`, `data-slot="error"`, `data-slot="success"`

DOM nesting: `root > label + description + wrapper(group) > SearchableDropdown + input + clearButton + hiddenInputs + statusLive + error + success`

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from InternationalPhoneInput.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | object | — | PhoneNumberValue - Controlled phone value with countryCode and phoneNumber fields. |
| `defaultValue` | object | — | PhoneNumberValue - Default phone value for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onValueChange` | object | — | (data: PhoneNumberData) => void - Fires when the phone number changes, providing full validation data. |
| `onCountryChange` | object | — | (country: CountryOption) => void - Fires when the selected country changes. |
| `defaultCountry` | string | `"us"` | ISO country code for the default selected country. |
| `countries` | array | — | Custom list of country options to display. |
| `preferredCountries` | array | — | ISO country codes to show at the top of the country list. |
| `id` | string | — | HTML id attribute. |
| `name` | string | — | Form field name. |
| `label` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the input. |
| `description` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Helper text displayed below the label. |
| `loading` | boolean | `false` | When true, the input is in a loading state. |
| `clearable` | boolean | `false` | When true, shows a clear button to reset the phone number. |
| `onClear` | object | — | () => void - Called when the clear button is clicked. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Marks the field as required. |
| `disabled` | boolean | `false` | Disables the input. |
| `readOnly` | boolean | `false` | Makes the input read-only. |
| `error` | boolean | `false` | Displays the input in an error state. |
| `errorMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the input. |
| `success` | boolean | `false` | Displays the input in a success state. |
| `successMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the input. |
| `placeholder` | string | `"Enter phone number"` | Placeholder text for the phone number input. |
| `fullWidth` | boolean | `false` | Makes the input span the full width of its container. |
| `validateOnBlur` | boolean | `true` | Validates the phone number when the input loses focus. |
| `validationMessage` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Custom validation message shown on blur validation. |
| `validate` | object | — | (data: PhoneNumberData) => boolean \| { valid: boolean; message?: string } - Authoritative custom validator. Overrides the built-in length check for both the emitted isValid and the blur error. For real number validation, use createLibphonenumberValidator() from @chumlab/ui/phone-validators. |
| `autoComplete` | string | — | Native input autocomplete. Defaults to "off" so browser autofill can't corrupt the national-number field; pass e.g. "tel-national" to opt in. |
| `pasteDetection` | boolean | `false` | Enables automatic detection and parsing of pasted phone numbers. |
| `copyFormat` | `"e164"` \| `"international"` \| `"national"` | `"e164"` | Format used when copying the phone number. |
| `onPasteDetect` | object | — | (data: PasteDetectedData) => void - Fires when a pasted number is recognised, with what it was understood to be. |
| `countryDropdownPlaceholder` | string | `"Country"` | Placeholder text for the country dropdown. |
| `countrySearchPlaceholder` | string | `"Search countries..."` | Placeholder text for the country search input. |
| `countryDropdownAriaLabel` | string | `"Select country"` | Accessible label for the country dropdown. |
| `numberAriaLabel` | string | `"Number"` | Accessible name of the number input. The group carries the field's name (`label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`); this names the part, so no label is announced twice. |
| `selectedIcon` | object | — | React.ReactNode - Custom icon for the selected country indicator. |
| `flagSize` | number | `22` | Pixel width of the flag rendered in the trigger and dropdown options. Height auto-scales at the 22:17 aspect ratio. Defaults to 22. |
| `renderCountryOption` | object | — | (props: CountryOptionRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for country options. |
| `renderSelectedCountry` | object | — | (country: CountryOption) => ReactNode - Custom render function for the selected country display. |
| `formatPatterns` | object | — | Record<string, PhoneFormatPattern> - Custom phone number formatting patterns by country. |
| `lengthRules` | object | — | Record<string, PhoneLengthRule> - Custom phone number length validation rules by country. |
| `className` | string | — | Additional CSS class for the root element. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the root element. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for sub-elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |
| `dropdownSide` | `"top"` \| `"bottom"` | — | Vertical placement of the country dropdown relative to the trigger. |
| `forceDropdownSide` | boolean | — | Locks the country dropdown to the specified position without auto-flipping. |
| `dropdownZIndex` | number | — | Z-index of the country dropdown popup. |
| `dropdownOffset` | number | — | Gap in pixels between trigger and country dropdown popup. |
| `portalContainer` | object | — | HTMLElement \| null - Portal target for the country dropdown. |
| `lockScroll` | boolean | — | Locks body scroll while the country dropdown is open. |

### Ref API

```tsx
import { useRef } from "react";
import { InternationalPhoneInput } from "@chumlab/ui/international-phone-input";

const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

// Focus the phone input
inputRef.current?.focus();

// Select all text
inputRef.current?.select();

// Read current value
console.log(inputRef.current?.value);

<InternationalPhoneInput ref={inputRef} label="Phone" />
```

---

### Styling Guide

> **A plain utility replaces the library's for that property, in every state.**
> `classes={{ slot: "text-red-500" }}` drops the library's `hover:text-…` and
> `data-[state=…]:text-…` on that slot as well — otherwise they would sit beside
> your class and win in their own state, leaving your override in the DOM and
> inert. Pass your own variant to keep one: `"text-red-500 hover:text-red-400"`.
> A variant YOU pass is never dropped.

#### How class merging works

1. **Default** (no `classes`, no `unstyled`) — uses `DEFAULT_INTERNATIONAL_PHONE_INPUT_CLASSES`
2. **Partial override** (`classes` without `unstyled`) — your classes compose with that slot's defaults; slots you don't name keep theirs.

**A plain utility of yours wins over every default in its group on that slot, states included.**
`classes={{ control: "bg-green-500" }}` paints green in every state, where a default
`data-[state=checked]:` background would otherwise keep winning. To restyle one state only,
pass that state's own variant (`data-[state=checked]:bg-green-500`). Defaults in other groups stay.

3. **Unstyled** (`unstyled={true}`) — all slots empty, you provide everything via `classes`

#### Slot → visual mapping

```
root
├── label
├── description
└── control (role="group")
    ├── countrySelect (SearchableDropdown, nested classes)
    │   ├── countrySelect.trigger
    │   ├── countrySelect.icon
    │   └── countrySelect.content (portal)
    │       ├── countrySelect.searchControl
    │       │   ├── countrySelect.searchIcon
    │       │   └── countrySelect.searchInput
    │       ├── countrySelect.list
    │       │   └── countrySelect.item [data-selected]
    │       │       └── countrySelect.itemIndicator
    │       └── countrySelect.empty
    ├── input
    └── clearButton (when clearable)
├── message
└── message
```

| "I want to change..." | Slot to use | Notes |
|------------------------|-------------|-------|
| Root container | `root` | Layout wrapper |
| Label styling | `label` | |
| Helper text | `description` | Below label |
| Input + dropdown row | `control` | `flex` container |
| Phone text input | `input` | The `<input type="tel">` |
| Country trigger button | `countrySelect.trigger` | Flag + dial code + chevron |
| Country dropdown panel | `countrySelect.content` | Portal-rendered |
| Country option row | `countrySelect.item` | Each country in list |
| Selected country highlight | | Additional class on selected |
| Check icon | `countrySelect.itemIndicator` | Selected indicator |
| Search input | `countrySelect.searchInput` | In dropdown |
| Error message | `message` | Below wrapper |
| Success message | `message` | Below wrapper |

#### Dark mode

Defaults use Tailwind `dark:` prefix, activated by `<html class="dark">`. When overriding slots, always provide both light and dark variants.

#### Styling via data attributes

```css
/* Tailwind arbitrary variant */
[data-error] .my-input { @apply border-red-500; }

/* Plain CSS */
[data-slot="input"][data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; }
```

#### Complete themed example

```tsx
<InternationalPhoneInput
  unstyled
  label="Phone"
  classes={{
    root: "flex flex-col gap-1",
    label: "text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200",
    control: "flex gap-2 items-stretch",
    input: "flex-1 h-10 px-3 rounded-md border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-sm outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500",
    // The country picker is a SearchableDropdown, and its slots are that
    // component's own — nested here rather than flattened into eleven
    // `countrySelect*` keys.
    countrySelect: {
      trigger: "flex items-center gap-2 h-10 px-3 rounded-md border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 min-w-[120px]",
      content: "w-72 border rounded-md shadow-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-800",
      list: "max-h-60 overflow-y-auto",
      item: "flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 data-selected:bg-indigo-50 dark:data-selected:bg-indigo-900/20",
      itemIndicator: "w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600",
      searchControl: "flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border-b",
      searchInput: "flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none text-sm",
      searchIcon: "w-4 h-4 text-gray-400",
      empty: "px-3 py-4 text-sm text-center text-gray-500",
      icon: "w-4 h-4 shrink-0",
    },
    message: "text-xs mt-1 text-red-500",
    description: "text-xs mt-1 text-gray-400",
  }}
/>
```

---

### Patterns

#### Controlled with validation feedback

```tsx
const [phone, setPhone] = useState<PhoneNumberData>();
<InternationalPhoneInput
  label="Phone"
  value={phone}
  onValueChange={setPhone}
  error={phone ? !phone.isValid : false}
  errorMessage="Invalid phone number"
/>
```

#### Paste detection with country auto-switch

```tsx
<InternationalPhoneInput
  pasteDetection
  onPasteDetect={(data) => console.log(data.detectedCountry?.name)}
  copyFormat="e164"
/>
```

#### Custom country subset

```tsx
const euCountries = [
  { value: "DE", label: "Germany (+49)", flag: "de", dialCode: "+49", name: "Germany" },
  { value: "FR", label: "France (+33)", flag: "fr", dialCode: "+33", name: "France" },
];
<InternationalPhoneInput countries={euCountries} defaultCountry="de" />
```

#### Force dropdown position with scroll lock

```tsx
<InternationalPhoneInput
  dropdownSide="bottom"
  forceDropdownSide
  lockScroll
/>
```

#### Form integration with hidden inputs

```tsx
<form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <InternationalPhoneInput name="phone" label="Phone" required />
  {/* Renders hidden inputs: phone (full number) and phone_country (country code) */}
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
```

---

### Forms

- **Submitted value.** With `name`, it submits two entries: `{name}_country`, the ISO country code, and `{name}`, the dial code followed by the digits (`+442071234567`; just the dial code when no number is typed).
- **Reset.** A form reset — a `type="reset"` button or `form.reset()` — restores an uncontrolled country and number to `defaultValue` (or the default country and no number), and the submitted value with it. Like a native input it fires no change callback: `onValueChange` is not called. A controlled InternationalPhoneInput is left alone: it keeps the `value` you pass and calls nothing, as a controlled React `<input>` does. Reset your own state in the form's `onReset` if you want the field cleared.
- **Required.** `required` is enforced by the number field itself: empty, it blocks the form's submit and the browser focuses it. The field shows an error state only when you pass `error` and `errorMessage`.
- **Disabled and `form`.** A disabled InternationalPhoneInput submits nothing, as a disabled native control doesn't. `form` reaches the submitted values as well as the number field.

### Keyboard Interactions

The number itself is a native `<input>`. The country selector is a listbox with its own keys.

| Key | Behaviour |
|-----|-----------|
| `Tab` | Moves between the country trigger and the number field. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the country list, and picks the focused country. |
| `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp` | Moves through countries. |
| `Escape` | Closes the country list. |
| Printable characters | Filters the country list by name or dial code. |

---

---

## Loader

> Animated loading indicators. Four variants: CircularLoader, LinearLoader, DotLoader, PulseLoader.

**Category:** Feedback
**Keywords:** loader, spinner, loading, progress, circular, linear, dots, pulse, skeleton

### Import

```tsx
import { CircularLoader, LinearLoader, DotLoader, PulseLoader } from "@chumlab/ui/loader";
```

---

### Basic Usage (copy-paste ready)

```tsx
import { CircularLoader } from "@chumlab/ui/loader";

export default function Example() {
  return <CircularLoader />;
}
```

---

### Data Attributes (for CSS selectors and testing)

- `data-reduce-motion="true"` on the root of all four variants — present only
  while reduced motion is in force, whether that comes from the OS setting or
  from `reduceMotion={true}`. Absent otherwise, so `[data-reduce-motion]`
  selects it.

---

### All Props

<!-- generated from Loader.schema.json — edit the schema, not this table -->

#### CircularLoader

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | number | `20` | Width and height in pixels. |
| `thickness` | number | `2` | Stroke width of track and arc. |
| `animationDuration` | number | `750` | One animation cycle, in milliseconds. Lower is faster. |
| `trackColor` | string | `"currentColor"` | Background track color, painted at 20% opacity by the `track` slot. |
| `reduceMotion` | `true` \| `false` \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting. |
| `classes` | object | — | CSS class overrides for sub-elements. |
| `unstyled` | boolean | `false` | Removes all default styling. |

#### LinearLoader

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|

| `animationDuration` | number | `1500` | One animation cycle, in milliseconds. Lower is faster. |
| `trackColor` | string | `"color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent)"` | Background track color. Defaults to the bar's colour at 20%, painted on the track only, so the bar keeps full strength. |
| `borderRadius` | number | `9999` | Border radius in pixels. |
| `reduceMotion` | `true` \| `false` \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting. |

| `reduceMotion` | `true` \| `false` \| `"auto"` | `"auto"` | Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting. |
